companies.renewableEnergy: Amazon matched 100% of electricity consumed by global operations with renewable energy in 2024, maintaining 621 projects with 33,485 MW capacity. It is the world's largest corporate purchaser of renewable energy.
companies.traditionalEnergy: Includes a 17-year PPA for 1.92 GW from the Susquehanna nuclear plant and grid capacity partnerships with utilities like SWEPCO and NIPSCO.
companies.sustainabilityInitiatives: Commitment to net-zero carbon by 2040, 100% renewable energy matching for global operations, and AWS water positivity goals (53% achieved by end-of-2024).

companies.renewableEnergy: Microsoft matches 100% of its global electricity consumption with renewable energy, having contracted 34-40 GW of carbon-free energy across 26 countries.
companies.traditionalEnergy: While the company matches 100% of consumption with renewables, it is actively integrating nuclear power (Crane Clean Energy Centre) and fusion technology (Helion) to support grid reliability.
companies.sustainabilityInitiatives: Commitment to be carbon negative by 2030; initiatives include geothermal integration at the Redmond campus, nuclear and fusion energy PPAs, use of low-carbon materials like CO2-injected concrete, and a $793 million Climate Innovation Fund.
